content: Hello! Kaafi din ho gaye, suna tumne mujse baat ki thi. Aaj kya haal hai? Koi specific cheez dekhna chahte ho apni emails mein?
HA WO TO HA MUJA SARI PROMOTIONAL EMAILS BTAOO KIYA AYI HOI HA

Bhai, tumhari promotional emails ki baat karte hain! Tumhari inbox mein ek email aayi hai jo "365 Video SEO Training Course (FREE)" ke bare mein hai, aur ye Chris M. Walker ki taraf se aayi hai. Ismein unhone apni training course ke bare mein bataya hai jo wo free mein de rahe hain. Ye email tumhari Promotions category mein hai. Aur haan, ye email kal aayi thi, 09 Jul 2026 ko.
ISKA ILAWA OR KOI EMAIL NAHI AYI HA

Bhai, tumne promotional emails ke baare mein pucha tha, aur maine tumhe kal aayi hui "365 Video SEO Training Course (FREE)" ki email ke bare mein bataya tha. Ab tum pooch rahe ho ki iske ilawa aur koi email aayi hai ya nahi. Tumhari inbox mein jo emails hain, wo sab personal category ki hain, jo Shah Zaman ki taraf se aayi hain, aur unmein sirf "aI" likha hai. Iske alawa, tumhari inbox mein jo emails hain, unmein se koi bhi promotional email nahi hai, jo tumhare sawal ke hisab se relevant ho.
OKEY  AJ KI JO AYI WOHI BTAODO PROMOTIONAL EMAILS

Bhai, aj ki promotional emails ki baat karte hain! Tumhari inbox mein kal aayi thi ek email jo "365 Video SEO Training Course (FREE)" ke bare mein thi, lekin wo kal aayi thi. Aj ki emails mein, tumhari inbox mein ek email aayi hai jo "☀️ 30% off Premium | Your summer offer is here" ke bare mein hai, aur ye TryHackMe ki taraf se aayi hai. Ye email tumhari Promotions category mein hai, aur ye aj nahi, kal aayi thi, 08 Jul 2026 ko. Aj tak tumhari inbox mein koi naye promotional email nahi aayi hai.
Tryhack me walo na hama promotional mail baji ha ham inko bejta ha

Bhai, tum TryHackMe walo ko promotional mail bhejna chahte ho? Theek hai, main tumhari madad karunga. Lekin pehle mujhe thoda aur detail chahiye. Tum unhe kya kehna chahte ho? Koi specific message ya subject hai jo tum unhe bhejna chahte ho?

acha unko mail bejo 
jiska subject ai ha 
or body bi ai ha

Bhai, tumne pehle hi bataya tha ki tum TryHackMe walo ko promotional mail bhejna chahte ho. Ab tumne subject aur body bhi specify kar diya hai, jo "AI" hai. Theek hai, main tumhari madad karunga.
